reason: The shown handler navigates a browser tab to a caller-supplied URL and includes a snapshot in the response. Browser-page activity is not arbitrary host code execution, so HOSTEXEC is not supported. Navigating to an agent-chosen URL can issue requests to attacker-readable destinations, so SINK is supported. The returned page snapshot can contain attacker-controlled web content, so UNTRUSTED is supported. Because the tool can navigate to URLs and return their contents/snapshot, and the cited README notes configurations allowing file:// access outside workspace roots, the lines support potential return of non-public/local URL contents, so SECRET is supported.
